text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before a race, I find Air Groove
quivering in the
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You fool. Quite the contrary. I am
absolutely
elated.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
After all, today I move one step closer
to
becoming a model for Umamusume
everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying. Keep your
eyes on the
Empress and witness my
victory!
